title: She Waited 200 Years to Marry Me #shorts

lines.text: I woke up at 3 AM and found a girl standing beside my bed.
Finally, you're awake. I've been waiting two hundred years to marry you.
I screamed so loudly that my neighbor called the police.
The next morning, I told my best friend everything.
Bro, you're officially single and still getting rejected by ghosts.
I laughed too... until I found a wedding ring on my finger.
Suddenly, my phone rang. Unknown number. I answered.
Daddy? When are you coming home?
I froze. Then my best friend looked at me and said,
Bro, you don't have a wife, right?
I slowly turned towards him. He was standing there... with the same wedding ring.
And then the lights went out.
A voice whispered in my ear:
Two husbands. One wife. Let the family reunion begin.
